verdict.rationale: Square ships an in-product AI assistant (Square AI), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Square's own MCP server, which exposes Square APIs to outside AI tools. That is the server role and does not count toward this client story. Nothing shows Square AI or any other Square surface accepting user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
